values.note: $5 per night for each added vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/mussigbrod-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night', 'There is a $15 per night fee for this campground, with an additional $5 for added vehicles.'; last updated April 30, 2026), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/mussigbrod-campground ('The campground has 10 units. The maximum recommended trailer length for the area is 30 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: ADA-accessible vault toilets, picnic tables, boat launch area and fishing access. No garbage service: pack out what you pack in.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/mussigbrod-campground ('ADA-accessible toilets, a boat launch area, and fishing access', 'Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site.', 'There is no garbage service at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS campground in a dense stand of lodgepole pine on the western shore of 102-acre Mussigbrod Lake (Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF, Wisdom RD, Big Hole area, ~6,500 ft). From Wisdom, 1 mi west on Hwy 43, 7.5 mi north on Lower North Fork Road, then 10 mi on Forest Road 573. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (Wisdom RD): confirmed 10 units, 30-ft recommended trailer max, $15 + $5 added vehicle, vault toilets; added potable water, season mid-June through September, no-garbage/boat-launch detail. Not stated: reservations/FCFS (agency row inherited, see flag), stay limit. Only the standing food-storage and pallet orders in alerts. Note trimmed of restated values.
